description: A routing module for game-related endpoints in an Express.js application, defining routes for starting AI games, making moves, retrieving game history, and fetching game details, with appropriate middleware for authentication.

methods.name: router.post('/start-ai')
methods.description: Route to start an AI game, protected by JWT authentication.

methods.name: router.post('/move')
methods.description: Route to make a move in a game, protected by JWT authentication.

methods.name: router.get('/history')
methods.description: Route to retrieve user game history, protected by JWT authentication.

methods.name: router.get('/detail/:id')
methods.description: Route to get detailed information about a specific game, protected by JWT authentication.
